verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents Markdown authoring with MDX support, including JSX syntax. It also lets writers add Mermaid diagrams via a slash command, use Font Awesome icons, and build custom MDX components. The evidence never names built-in tabs, callouts, code groups or steps, and "fully custom MDX components" points to building your own rather than using ready-made ones. Missing for 10: documented built-in tabs, callouts, code groups and steps components; independent or hands-on corroboration of the component authoring experience.
